slither.scope: contracts/src (V1: Bond, IntentLog, JobBoard, Lease; V2: BondV2, IntentLogV2); lib, test and script excluded

findings.summary: JobBoard._pay(address,uint256) (src/JobBoard.sol#175) sends eth to arbitrary user
findings.reason: Recipients are the rail (fixed in the constructor) and the job's agent (fixed when the job is posted). The caller cannot choose them.

V1 Lease.pay. The balance is cut before the call to the lender, and the title step is guarded by the `owned` flag, so a re-entering lender can only pay more into its own lease. No funds can be taken. Mitigation: lenders are known parties set when the lease is created; Lease is not redeployed, so the fix is operational.

findings.summary: IntentLog.commit(bytes32,bytes32) (src/IntentLog.sol#29-33) uses a dangerous strict equality:
findings.reason: `at == 0` checks that an intent was not committed yet. No balance or timing value is compared.

findings.summary: JobBoard.confirm(uint256).instalment (src/JobBoard.sol#96) is a local variable never initialized
findings.reason: Zero is the intended default: shadow jobs pay no instalment and no bond top up.

findings.summary: JobBoard.confirm(uint256).toBond (src/JobBoard.sol#97) is a local variable never initialized
findings.reason: Zero is the intended default: shadow jobs pay no instalment and no bond top up.

findings.summary: IntentLogV2.commit(bytes32,bytes32) (src/v2/IntentLogV2.sol#58-67) ignores return value by (None,jobAgent,None,None,None,None,None,None,None) = board.jobs(uint256(jobId)) (src/v2/IntentLogV2.sol#60)
findings.reason: Tuple destructuring of the board's `jobs()` getter. Only the agent and status fields are needed; the others are skipped on purpose.

findings.summary: BondV2._ranJob(IBonded.Intent) (src/v2/BondV2.sol#248-251) ignores return value by (None,jobAgent,None,None,None,None,None,None,status) = board.jobs(uint256(i.jobId)) (src/v2/BondV2.sol#249)
findings.reason: Tuple destructuring of the board's `jobs()` getter. Only the agent and status fields are needed; the others are skipped on purpose.
